scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/mcu-schema && npm run build --prefix packages/mcu-language && npm run build --prefix packages/mcu-lsp && npm run build --prefix extension && npm run copy-extension-assets
scripts.copy-extension-assets: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const d=p.join('extension','server');fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(p.join('packages','mcu-lsp','dist','server.js'),p.join(d,'server.js'));const v=p.join('extension','vendor','mcu-schema');fs.rmSync(v,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync(p.join('packages','mcu-schema','dist'),v,{recursive:true});console.log('LSP + mcu-schema copied to extension/');"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix packages/mcu-schema && npm run test --prefix packages/mcu-language && npm run test --prefix packages/mcu-geometry && npm run test --prefix packages/mcu-lsp && npm run test --prefix extension
